data.narrative:
Shift5 is a Series C defense and security company that has raised $180.5M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 13 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Helsing, Saronic, Quantum-Systems, Chaos Industries, and Dream Security, with valuations ranging from $300M to $18.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $180.5M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $307M. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company comp set produces a median valuation of $2.1B, with a published range of $300M at the low end (Dream Security, Series B) and $18.0B at the high end (Helsing, Series D). The wide range reflects heterogeneity in stage progression and market position within the defense-tech sector.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $261M (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The considerable spread between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects Shift5's early position relative to later-stage funded peers. Key uncertainties include Shift5's specific market positioning, revenue traction, and customer concentration relative to the peer set, all of which would materially influence placement within this range.
